write_up: You’ve progressed from warehouse work to dispatch assistant and dispatcher at a regional freight company. A recruiter can see the direction, but the current role doesn’t say how many drivers or loads you handle, or what your work has achieved.

The line about tracking loads and updating customers is the best model: it names both the work and who receives it. Give the other dispatch bullets that same detail, then add volume or results where you can verify them.

cards.cannot_tell: This names the work and the people receiving the updates. It’s a useful model for the other bullets.
